notes: A frontend rebuild no longer takes the live site down. The current site stays up until the new build succeeds.
Admin → Update can rebuild only the frontend when the backend is already on the latest version.
added: Rebuild frontend on the update page, including after a build was killed for memory.
changed: Next.js builds skip the interactive security-upgrade prompt that deleted .next.
The build checks free memory and swap first and caps the Node heap so a small server is not killed mid-build.
